body:
@MWhiteley I think you're right -- from reading the code it appears that header names/values that are larger than 4k cannot be decoded. Thanks for reporting!

@wgallagher do you want to take a look? We could either go back to using a dynamic buffer, or use a static buffer with a capacity of maxHeaderSize, or try to decode into a composite cumulation buffer if the decode buffer isn't writable. Thoughts?

issue.title: Help: DefaultPromise not completed when opening Http2StreamChannel from Http2StreamChannelBootstrap

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
I'm using OpenJDK 21.0.2_13. When virtual threads execute the following code, opening an Http2StreamChannel should complete instantly. However, all virtual threads are stuck waiting for the DefaultPromise to complete and have been in this state for several days.


        Http2StreamChannel http2StreamChannel = null;
        try {
            http2StreamChannel = this.streamChannelBootstrap.open().get();
        } catch (ExecutionException e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("failed to create a http2 stream", e);
        }
